description: List the tokenized real-world assets this server knows by symbol, with their Solana mint and the security each one tracks. Every other tool also accepts a raw mint address, so this list is a starting point rather than a limit.

assetType.description: Filter by what the token tracks. Funds cover index, treasury, and commodity fund shares.

query.description: Filter by substring against symbol, name, or tracked ticker. For example "gold", "AAPL", or "bank".

name: list_rwa_assets
title: List tokenized assets
